Model 2 delivers a more intense and overt performance of crying. It includes more pronounced vocal fry, cracks in the voice (e.g., on 'sad'), and a very distinct sob/gasp at the end (around 4:00). This performance is more dynamic and arguably closer to what one might imagine as 'crying' in a more dramatic sense. The non-linguistic vocalizations are more varied and explicit.

The difference is significant.
